newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs says Macritonin results due by May 2.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs says Macritonin results due by May 2.

text.p: Anglo-Australian drugs and diagnostics group Cortecs International Ltd said on Monday it would receive the results of clinical trials for its Macritonin drug no later than May 2.

Phase II/III of trials for Macritonin -- a new drug for treating the bone-wasting illness osteoporosis -- are conducted independently and Cortecs says it has no control over when the results are released. It said it would announce the data as soon as practicable.
Analysts have said the company's share price could rise sharply if the results are positive.
